messages:
incident-bot: Pager — High error rate detected in prod-inference cluster (us-west). 503s + crashloops on rollout-2026-03-17-featuregate. Threshold breached: 22% error rate.

miguel-oncall: looking. assigning to SRE/ENG. @lee-sre @ashwin-eng can you join?

lee-sre: I see repeated crashloopbackoffs on deployment inference-workers-v2. Killed pods restarting with OOMKilled in the last 3m.

ashwin-eng: this rollout toggled feature_flag=fast-batching. suspect memory regression in collector path. rolling pods have higher RSS.

natalie-support: any customer impact so far? support dashboard shows ~12 active customers seeing inference timeouts. 5 are high-traffic.

miguel-oncall: set severity P1 given customer impact. quick mitigation plan: 1) turn feature flag off 2) scale down new release 3) if needed rollback to previous image.

ashwin-eng: attempting flag kill: PATCH to config-service done. flag=off returned 200. Confirming propagation.

ops-rotation: flag change propagated to 2/3 control planes. One control plane reporting stale cache. running cache-invalidate job.

lee-sre: while flag is propagating, HPA is flapping. replicas oscillating 3 <-> 12 causing more churn. I'm going to pause HPA for the inference-workers HPA (kubectl patch).

ashwin-eng: run this to pause HPA temporarily:
```
kubectl patch hpa inference-workers --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3,"maxReplicas":3}}' -n prod
```
Applied. HPA fixed at 3 replicas.

miguel-oncall: good. we should also cordon any node with repeated OOMs to stabilize scheduling. lee, can you identify nodes?

lee-sre: nodes gke-prod-pool-3-a and -b show repeated OOM eviction events. cordoning gke-prod-pool-3-b now and draining slow pods.

ashwin-eng: rolling restart old image on remaining replicas to ensure clean heap. deploying rollback image inference:v2026-03-10.

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered by ashwin-eng: rollout inference deployment inference-workers -> image inference:v2026-03-10 (strategy: recreate).

miguel-oncall: monitoring metrics. error rate dropped from 22% -> 4% over last 4m. crashloops reduced.

natalie-support: updating customers: posted notice to affected accounts, CS escalation for top 5. Will follow up with incident summary.

ashwin-eng: logs show root cause: fast-batching enabled an edge code path that buffers tensors, increasing peak memory by ~30% on specific sequence lengths. Repro locally. We'll add safer memory cap and a feature gate check before enabling.

lee-sre: handoff: I'm going to continue stabilizing nodes and verify no further OOMs for next 30m. @ops-rotation you'll take next on-call.

ops-rotation: acknowledged, taking handoff at 3723457689. Please add any follow-up action items to the incident doc.

miguel-oncall: incident P1 -> downgraded to P2: system stable. Postmortem and remediation plan (fix memory cap, add canary traffic limits, improve HPA smoothing) assigned to ashwin-eng and lee-sre.

sara-dev: I'll prepare a patch for feature flag to gate on memory headroom + add unit test for buffer sizing.

incident-bot: Incident resolved? Marking responder list. Please file postmortem link when created. :white_check_mark:
